waypoints.name: Airlock (Amundsen Hab)
waypoints.desc: Primary habitat airlock egress onto baseline pebble regolith with low-slope exit vector.
waypoints.science: Suit seal integrity verification, baseline radiometer calibration, and primary navigation beacon handshake.

mastcam.geology: Deflation lag of basaltic gravels and pebbles over mudstone bedrock.

waypoints.name: Ridge Fracture Alpha
waypoints.desc: Exhumed hydrothermal mineral vein network intersecting the primary boxwork ridge crest.
waypoints.science: Micro-Raman spectroscopy of cross-cutting light-toned calcium-sulfate vein precipitates.

mastcam.geology: Two-generation mineral fracture fillings standing in high relief after wind erosion.

waypoints.name: Rover Drop / Deep Core
waypoints.desc: Flat bedrock terrace rendezvous with autonomous rover; pneumatic drill core sampling.
waypoints.science: Pneumatic 1.5m drill core into unweathered high-silica phyllosilicate strata.

mastcam.geology: Tridymite-rich layered bedrock displaying grey drill powder tailings and rover tracks.

waypoints.name: Boxwork Polygon Hollow
waypoints.desc: Protected depression enclosed by polygonal ridge walls containing active basalt ripples.
waypoints.science: Grain-size distribution profiling and volatile release analysis of coarse eolian ripples.

mastcam.geology: Eolian basaltic deflation sand ripples surrounded by boxwork polygon crests.

waypoints.name: Sulfate Ridge Escarpment
waypoints.desc: High vantage point on prominent escarpment ridge overlooking Mount Sharp sulfate stratigraphy.
waypoints.science: Stereoscopic photogrammetry of cross-bedded eolian sandstone and regional fault contacts.

mastcam.geology: Towering layered sandstone and sulfate-bearing mesa standing 15 meters above crater floor.
